notes.title: Antioma Hotfix 1
notes.notes: [p]It's been almost two days since the release of Antioma. We've been watching streams, playthroughs, and gathering your feedback. So, here's the first small hotfix addressing the issues you've already spotted.[/p][p align="start"][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed incorrect dialogue being assigned to the wrong characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various visual glitches.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues in minigames that could lead to softlocks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare bug preventing interaction with certain objects.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]This won't be the last hotfix—we're still working on more improvements. Please keep sending your bug reports if you find anything![/p]

notes.title: Antioma Demo — Release Patch
notes.notes: [p]Antioma launches in just two days, and we're rolling out a major update to the demo! It now fully represents the final quality of the game, complete with new music, characters' voices, and professional translations.[/p][p align="start"]Help Kiddo escape from the hospital on his Birthday![/p][p align="start"][b]A note for players who are getting the full version:[/b] To avoid potential issues with transferring your save data (we've tested everything, but we can't rule out all risks), we advise you to either:[/p][list][*][p]Wait two days and start fresh with the full version.[/p][/*][*][p]Or start a new game after the full version is out.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]If you're feeling adventurous, you can always try to transfer your save, we did our best to make it work! :)[/p][p align="start"]Changes:[/p][list][*][p]Added 5 new music tracks.[/p][/*][*][p]All characters now have voices, and the most important cutscenes feature complete voice acting.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated localization: All translations have been done manually and now match the languages available in the full game.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various bugs.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]See you on September 10th![/b][/p]

notes.title: New release date for Antioma
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! We have some very important news.[/p][p]Unfortunately, we won’t be able to release Antioma on August 14th as originally planned. An unexpected delay has occurred, and we need a bit more time to polish the game. [/p][p]The new release date is [u]September 10th (7:00 am PDT, 3:00 pm CET)[/u], and we’re fully confident in it. In fact, we expect to finish work well before that deadline. The game is already fully playable, but we just need to bring a few aspects up to the proper quality.[/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and support!
[/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest and the first patch for Antioma Demo!
notes.notes: [p]We’ve rolled out the first patch for the Antioma demo! In preparation for Steam Next Fest, we’ve polished and expanded the game so returning players can enjoy a bit more content, while newcomers get an even smoother experience. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p]- Added a cutscene at the end of the demo[/p][p]- Added a bit of music[/p][p]- Added localization for 4 more languages[/p][p]- Added credits[/p][p]- Added a dedicated error-reporting option[/p][p]- Added/updated several sound effects[/p][p]- Added achievements (try getting them all!)[/p][p]- Minor fixes[/p][p]The update is already available for download — jump back in and check it out![/p]
